questions.stem: What is the passage mainly about?
questions.explanation: The passage says: "The community centre invites young people to help design a quiet reading corner. I take an active part in the meeting by asking questions and showing a sketch. Several neighbours suggest wide seats and shelves that children can reach easily. We write down every suggestion before deciding which ideas fit the small room. One sketch puts a shelf in front of the window and blocks the daylight. After comparing the drawings, we move that shelf to a side wall. Our final plan uses ideas from several people, and everyone can explain a useful change." This supports the answer: "Combining people’s ideas into a useful reading corner plan".
questions.parentExplanation: 对应原文：社区中心邀请年轻人协助设计安静的阅读角。 我在会上提问、展示草图，积极参与讨论。 几位邻居建议用宽座椅和孩子容易够到的书架。 我们记下每条建议，再决定哪些适合这个小房间。 一张草图把书架摆在窗前，挡住了日光。 比较图画后，我们把那架子改放侧墙。 最终方案采用几个人的想法，每个人都能解释一项有用的调整。 因此正确选项为“Combining people’s ideas into a useful reading corner plan”。

questions.stem: Which title best fits the passage?
questions.explanation: The answer is “A Clear Sign Helps Shorten a Queue”. Evidence: Our museum group notices that visitors wait a long time at the ticket desk. We think about the problem before suggesting any changes to the staff. For an hour, we record what questions people ask when they reach the front. Many only need to know which ticket includes the special exhibition. A clear sign near the entrance could cut down the waiting time at the desk. The staff try our idea the next weekend and compare the length of the queue. Their notes show a shorter line, so they keep the sign and thank our group.
questions.parentExplanation: 正确项为“A Clear Sign Helps Shorten a Queue”。原文依据：博物馆小组注意到，来客在售票台等得很久。 我们先思考这个问题，再向工作人员提建议。 一小时里，我们记录人们排到前面时问的问题。 很多人只想知道哪种票包含特别展览。 入口旁一块清楚的标牌可以缩短售票台等候时间。 工作人员下周末试用我们的想法，比较队列长度。 记录显示队伍变短，因此他们保留标牌，感谢我们小组。
